samples.description: One annual outcome observation for each year(FPEDATS) 1984–1999, constructed from eligible I/B/E/S U.S. Detail History quarterly EPS firm-quarter observations with report_curr=USD and CURR_ACT=USD after selecting the latest strictly pre-report individual forecast.

assumptions: The paper reports a univariate trend regression but does not identify the estimator or covariance method; OLS with a constant and conventional standard errors is used as best effort.
year(FPEDATS) is the operational fiscal-year proxy because the selected Detail table has no separate fiscal-year label.

The most recent individual forecast strictly before ANNDATS_ACT is selected; missing times rank below observed times. Analyst, estimator, and value order resolve exact latest-datetime ties; no forecast-age cap is imposed.
Only rows with both report_curr=USD and CURR_ACT=USD enter the common-cent sample. CURRFL is treated as received forecast currency, not as the stored forecast denomination.
Current I/B/E/S adjusted Detail values are used without rounding; the contemporaneous paper vintage and historical split-adjustment precision cannot be recovered.

limitations: The common-USD sample contains 190,006 selected firm-quarter events versus the paper’s 176,519 (+13,487; +7.64%). The source diagnostics report no multiple eligible report dates or actual values within TICKER×FPEDATS, but the vintage/population difference remains unexplained.
The selected Detail table has no separate fiscal-year label; year(FPEDATS) is the operational grouping proxy for the paper’s fiscal year representing each firm-quarter.

Current I/B/E/S Detail History is a later data vintage. Historical revisions, split-adjustment precision, and differences from the paper’s contemporaneous vendor file may affect the sample and annual statistics.

The paper identifies a univariate trend regression but not the estimator or covariance method. The nine annual fits use OLS with conventional standard errors as an explicit best-effort choice; Stata reports two-sided p-values and signed t-statistics, while the paper prints positive t-value magnitudes.

The 47 selected rows with report_curr=USD but CURR_ACT=CAD are excluded after forecast selection because no authorized conversion input is available to make actual and forecast currencies comparable. Non-USD or missing report_curr is also excluded. CURRFL=C is retained when report_curr=USD because it marks received-estimate currency, not stored VALUE denomination.

The 2009 I/B/E/S guide documents an Actuals-file date convention change before January 1999. The build uses the explicit ANNDATS_ACT field as the report date and audits it against ACTDATS_ACT and FPEDATS, but the historical event-date meaning cannot be established for all current-vintage records.
